working_title: The boxes I thought I needed

exercise.instructions: You are going to read an article about moving to a smaller home. Six sentences have been removed from the article. Choose from the sentences A–G the one which fits each gap (37)–(42). There is one extra sentence which you do not need to use.
exercise.text_title: The boxes I thought I needed
exercise.passage_with_gaps:
Moving into a smaller home was supposed to be a fresh start. However, as I sat surrounded by boxes labelled "keep", I realised that my new living space was noticeably smaller than the last. (37) I could barely move around without tripping over something.

One of the boxes caught my attention. It contained an object I had kept for years, just in case I might need it. (38) I couldn't even remember the last time I had used it, yet here it was, taking up precious space.

Instead of simply throwing things away, I discovered a local swap and repair event. (39) It seemed like a perfect opportunity to deal with my clutter in a more meaningful way.

At the event, I hesitantly laid out several items, unsure if anyone would find them useful. To my surprise, a visitor eagerly picked up the object I thought nobody would want. (40) Meanwhile, a sentimental item that I had brought along returned home with me.

Back in my flat, I began to develop a more deliberate rule for what deserved space. (41) However, I decided to keep a few impractical objects for personal reasons.

As I placed the sentimental object back on the shelf, I realised that my approach to possessions had changed. (42) No longer was it about owning fewer things, but about understanding the value they held.
